comments.author: @kp2223
comments.text:
I work for a legal team , and a pension finance department of a major financial investment firm. The amount of our clients I have to tell that if they offer an AI Chatbot to be their customer service that they are legally required to fulfill, whatever the AI has promised is insane. These people are well educated and very well versed in their subject matter.And don't seem to understand that if a company like delta outsources their customer service to an ai they have to honor everything the ai rep says. 
We recently saw a case where an airline.Chatbot told a customer that if they required a flight for bereavement and had to pay full price.Now, they would be reimbursed for the difference of a bereavement flight cost. The airline said they weren't going to pay the difference.Because they never confirmed that they would without acknowledging that the ai chatbot, which they had a record of did say that. The federal government has just ruled that if your company uses an ai chatbot.Instead of employing a person with knowledge and skills of the industry.And company regulations then they are legally liable for whatever the ai chatbot says. So that airline had to pay the difference.And had to pay all the legal fees of this man who had just lost his father and now had to sue the airline.Because he couldn't afford the cost.Difference on an emergency flight.
